_meta.name: sem-mean-structure-and-groups
_meta.description: The two-factor CFA of survey.pulse (service =~ q1 + q2 + q3, value =~ q4 + q5 + q6) on the lavaan path, then across the two panel waves as ONE joint multi-group fit. means sets meanstructure: lavaan's ML fit with free intercepts (x ~1 rows), Wald ci_lower / ci_upper columns and implied_means / observed_means. configural adds group panel: every parameter free per wave, estimate rows keyed [level] lval op rval with vectors.group and vectors.label, per-wave auxiliaries (implied_covariance.a, observed_means.b, ...) and joint scalars plus chi2_group_<level> / n_group_<level>. scalar holds loadings and intercepts equal (group_equal), which frees the latent means of wave b (wave a, the group_reference, stays 0): the [b] service ~1 and [b] value ~1 rows are each factor's shift in marker units. partial frees the q3 intercept again (group_partial q3~1). Compare chi2, dof, cfi and rmsea from configural to scalar to read measurement invariance. Streamable and mergeable: each wave's means and covariance merge on their own.
